blastoff: Something's been building in this branch. Quietly. For months.
A new financial year, thirty days old, and every goal plan is in.
One sign-in now. One app. The system sets your day, and the wall shows the score.
This is the part where we come out.
Last week Akaash and I took this branch to the company. Our record, on the table.
Friday, twelve noon, we come back to you. Not to brief you. To hear you.
Everything you write before Friday is read in the room. In silence. Before anybody speaks.
The quietest person in this branch, read as carefully as the loudest.
So open the meetings page, and answer three questions. Say the thing you'd say in the car park.
